events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Detroit Tigers

headlines.description: — Freddy Peralta pitched six scoreless innings and picked up his first win with his new team as the Tampa Bay Rays beat the Detroit Tigers 3-0 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Freddy Peralta's six scoreless innings leads Rays to 3-0 win over Tigers

headlines.description: — Eduardo Rodriguez struck out nine in seven innings, Jordan Lawlar homered and the Arizona Diamondbacks beat the Chicago Cubs 2-0 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eduardo Rodriguez strikes out 9 in 7 innings as Diamondbacks beat Cubs 2-0

events.name: Cincinnati Reds at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Eugenio Suarez hit a grand slam as part of Cincinnati’s seven-run ninth inning as the Reds overcame a six-run deficit and beat the San Francisco Giants 10-9 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eugenio Suarez's grand slam highlights 7-run 9th inning as the Reds rally past Giants 10-9

events.name: Cleveland Guardians at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Steven Kwan hit a tying double in the ninth inning, Travis Bazzana followed with a sacrifice fly and the Cleveland Guardians rallied past the Los Angeles Angels 4-3 on Wednesday for their seventh straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kwan and Bazzana lift streaking Guardians to 4-3 comeback win over Angels

headlines.description: — Kyle Schwarber hit his MLB-leading 40th home run, Jesús Luzardo struck out nine in seven innings and the Philadelphia Phillies beat the Seattle Mariners 6-0 Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Schwarber hits MLB-leading 40th homer, Luzardo fans 9 as Phillies beat Mariners 6-0

events.name: Pittsburgh Pirates at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Jackson Merrill doubled, tripled, drove in a run and scored another to help Randy Vásquez reach 10 victories as the San Diego Padres beat the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-0 on Wednesday to avoid a three-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Merrill, Vásquez lead the Padres to a 3-0 victory over the Pirates

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Miami Marlins

headlines.description: — Javier Sanoja had three hits and drove in a run, Ryan Gusto limited Boston to four hits in 5 2/3 innings and the Miami Marlins beat the Red Sox 4-0 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sanoja, Gusto help Marlins beat Red Sox 4-0 to avoid series sweep

headlines.description: — Connor Norby hit a grand slam, Troy Johnston, Cole Carrigg and Hunter Goodman had two-run homers, and the Colorado Rockies beat the Washington Nationals 13-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Connor Norby's grand slam and 3 2-run homers help Rockies to a 13-1 win over the Nationals

events.name: Houston Astros at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Cody Bellinger hit a go-ahead double with the bases loaded in the seventh inning and the New York Yankees pulled away for a 9-3 victory over the Houston Astros on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cody Bellinger hits a tiebreaking double in the 7th inning as the Yankees beat the Astros 9-3

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Seven Toronto pitchers combined on a six-hitter, Nathan Lukes hit a three-run homer and the Blue Jays beat the Royals 3-0 on Wednesday night, ending Kansas City’s nine-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nathan Lukes homers and Blue Jays end Royals' 9-game winning streak with 3-0 victory

events.name: Milwaukee Brewers at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Brice Turang hit a three-run homer and the Milwaukee Brewers beat the New York Mets 8-1 on Wednesday night, overcoming an injury to starter Dustin May...
headlines.shortLinkText: Brewers overcome Dustin May's early injury to rout the Mets 8-1

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Atlanta Braves

headlines.description: — Pinch-hitter Ha-Seong Kim singled home Lane Thomas with two outs in the ninth inning, lifting the Atlanta Braves to a 6-5 win over the Los Angeles Dodgers on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Braves beat Dodgers 6-5 on walk-off single by pinch-hitter Ha-Seong Kim

events.name: Texas Rangers at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Tristan Peters homered for the fifth consecutive game to match the franchise record and MLB rookie mark, Brenton Doyle hit a three-run shot and the Chicago White Sox beat the Texas Rangers 10-4 on Wednesday night in the rubber match of a three-game...
headlines.shortLinkText: Tristan Peters homers for 5th consecutive game, White Sox beat Rangers 10-4

events.name: Baltimore Orioles at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Christian Encarnacion-Strand hit a tiebreaking RBI double, Leody Taveras and Pete Alonso homered and the Baltimore Orioles beat the St. Louis Cardinals 8-7 on Wednesday night after squandering a seven-run, second-inning lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Encarnacion-Strand hits tiebreaking RBI double in the 9th as Orioles outlast Cardinals 8-7

headlines.description: — Lawrence Butler homered, Alika Williams hit a two-run triple and the Athletics beat the Minnesota Twins 7-4 on Wednesday night to win the three-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Butler homers and Williams hits a 2-run triple as the Athletics beat the Twins 7-4
